subject: Whisperwood cutover - unexpected deadpath and security group blackhole
messages:
From: Samir Das <samir.das@whisperwoodhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: infra-ops@whisperwoodhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Cutover impact - intermittent outbound timeouts and service errors

Hi Lauren,

We completed the Whisperwood private-cutover at 03:00 UTC and immediately started seeing a subset of outbound flows appear to be blackholed. Users report timeouts hitting our third-party analytics and some internal downstream APIs returning 502/504 intermittently.

What we observed so far:
- ~4% of requests to a subset of public endpoints time out (client TCP SYNs don't get ACKs).
- Traces show post-cutover next-hop changes for a handful of prefixes; some TTLs expire.
- We rolled a security change earlier this morning (default deny egress + explicit allow list).

I attached a pcap (network-trace-20261201.pcap) and a snapshot of our SGs (sg-policy-snapshot.json). Can Redwood confirm if the private agent expects any ephemeral egress ranges or specific routing behavior? This is impacting production.

Quick ask: can we get someone to triage and recommend an immediate mitigation to restore stable egress while we investigate root cause?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Das
Platform Lead, Whisperwood Health

Attachments: network-trace-20261201.pcap, sg-policy-snapshot.json

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Samir Das <samir.das@whisperwoodhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover impact - intermittent outbound timeouts and service errors

Samir — thanks for the details and the files. We're on it. Initial triage plan:
1) Confirm whether this is primarily a routing next-hop issue or an SG/conntrack problem.
2) If SGs are blocking ephemeral ranges, suggest a temporary allow rule for outbound ephemeral ports while we do a deeper root cause.
3) If routes look stale, we'll give a small set of commands to validate and force a route refresh.

Connor and Rishi, can you pick this up? Connor, please start with the pcap and SG snapshot. Rishi, please look at the routing change history and any recent policy-based routing (PBR) or route-map updates on the transit.

Samir — please keep the infra-ops alias in the loop for any quick rules you need to apply. We'll try to avoid a lengthy VPN cutover rollback if possible.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

(Note: attaching NET ticket NET-9876, added to related links)

Date: 2026-12-01T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover impact - intermittent outbound timeouts and service errors

Quick summary from routing perspective:
- We saw the cutover announcement; the transit router at Whisperwood changed route preference for some /24s to the new handoff. The new path is fine for most prefixes, but a minority are resolving to a dark next-hop (likely a missing next-hop install on the leaf edge).
- If conntrack entries survive the transition, asymmetric return path plus SNAT mismatch can lead to apparent blackholing from the app's perspective.
